title: Anthropic models will be removed from AWS GovCloud IL5 workspaces
body:
On September 19, 2026, Anthropic models will be removed from Databricks on AWS GovCloud and AWS GovCloud DoD workspaces that have the DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) compliance standard selected. After this date, IL5 workspaces can't create or use endpoints that serve Anthropic models. Migrate any affected endpoints to another supported model before September 19, 2026.

See [DoD IL5](/aws/en/security/privacy/il5).
